none: PAS NLM-49CA2F: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine, Lyons mint fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust laureate mantled or cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [?DN] CO[---]. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. In exergue: PLG. Diameter: 15.3mm, Weight: 1.95gms, die axis: 12
